meta.source: Charville CODEX, Wu et al. 2022, Zenodo 13179600, CC-BY-4.0
meta.label: MEASURED cells
meta.selection: 36 cores, one per patient: hero Charville_c003_v001_r001_reg112 (CHV-24133) plus 35 patients drawn uniformly (seed 7), each patient's largest region
meta.downsampling: grid cores: uniform random sample of at most 2500 cells without replacement, seed 7; hero core: every cell
meta.units: x, y in microns from the region's min-x, min-y corner, 0.1 um; t indexes types
meta.marker_scale: q = clip(round((v - lo) / (hi - lo) * 255), 0, 255); v is the source's normalised intensity, lo/hi the 1st/99th percentile over the exported cells
